name: AgentPay Canonical Protocol Error Taxonomy
description: Language-agnostic canonical error codes, HTTP status mappings, domains, and error response schema shared across Python SDK, Go Gateway, and Web Console.

errors.actionable: Parse PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge and attach valid PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

errors.message: Wallet available balance is insufficient to cover this request.
errors.actionable: Top up wallet balance via admin grant, onchain transfer, or fiat deposit. Silent downgrade to onchain payment is strictly forbidden.

errors.message: Wallet account is currently frozen or in arrears status.
errors.actionable: Contact administrator or clear arrears balance to restore wallet active status.

errors.message: Requested payment method is not permitted by route policy.
errors.actionable: Review route configuration for allowed payment methods ('wallet', 'onchain', or 'both').

errors.message: 24-hour rolling or lifetime budget ceiling exhausted.
errors.actionable: Increase project/tenant budget cap or await rolling window expiration.

errors.message: Single transaction amount exceeds maximum per-request policy limit.
errors.actionable: Adjust transaction amount or reconfigure policy max_amount_per_request.

errors.message: Circuit breaker triggered due to runaway agent loops or high request frequency.
errors.actionable: Cool down request dispatch loop or wait for automatic probe recovery window.

errors.message: Provided API Key is invalid, revoked, or expired.
errors.actionable: Verify Bearer token or obtain a newly generated active API Key from console.

errors.message: API Key lacks required permission scope for this operation.
errors.actionable: Grant appropriate scope (e.g. 'gateway:call') to the API Key.
Contact platform super-admin to reinstate tenant account.

errors.message: EIP-712 / EIP-3009 payment signature verification failed or payload tampered.
errors.actionable: Verify private key, CAIP-2 network domain separator, and signer address.

errors.message: AgentPay wallet authorization is invalid, expired, mismatched, or already consumed.
errors.actionable: Obtain a fresh PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge and retry with the matching wallet authorization.

errors.message: This route requires an AgentPay virtual-wallet API key.
errors.actionable: Send an active AgentPay API key to receive the wallet price challenge.

errors.message: Cryptographic nonce has already been consumed or submitted.
errors.actionable: Generate a fresh 32-byte cryptographic random nonce.

errors.message: Idempotency key collision with mismatched payload hash or in-flight concurrent execution.
errors.actionable: Use a new unique idempotency key or wait for in-flight request resolution.

errors.message: Internal wallet hold reservation expired before upstream completion.
errors.actionable: Retry request with fresh hold lease.

errors.message: Gateway timed out awaiting upstream API execution.
errors.actionable: Retry with exact same Idempotency-Key (free idempotent replay).
Investigate upstream service availability; retry with same Idempotency-Key.

errors.message: Route configuration version has been superseded or rolled back during execution.
errors.actionable: Refresh local gateway route snapshot and retry.
